review_description: Solar quote web sight was a great help to give me some starting information ended up going with a fourth quote as the third one was going to make me wait 4 week before they could come out so phoned best value and got a 5kw SMA inverter 20 panels, 10 west facing on a cradle on garage roof and 10 north on the house roof the guys did it all in a day and all is good
